text: This game takes a colossal amount of storage. I loaded BV onto a brand new tablet a few days ago and it is the first, and only, app I've installed on it. Storage space was about 53% when first installed. This has now gone up to a whopping 30.8GB/32GB (96%) within just a few days and I haven't used the tablet for anything else at all. This makes the game run slow and clunky. I've cleared caches, etc, with no effect. A few other issues as well but need more space here to explain.

Used to be great! I played a lot and I've got to Level 281, but these last few weeks I'm hardly winning, the bets cost double what you win, you need at least 2 bingo's to break even and i very rarely get 1. 2 months ago I had over 200k tickets, now I've got 93k, playing exactly the same but the algorithms must have changed. I'm really struggling to keep playing as its so demotivating, seeing my ticket numbers fall and nothing I can do about it. Please, whatever you changed, please change it back

I am a lady in my later years and enjoy playing 2 cards at a time, which I can see and my brain can click into the called numbers quite well. But going from 2 cards to 4 cards for better prizes is too much as my brain is not quick enough. We oldies would like to up our prizes but for some like myself the option of 2 cards to 4 is too much. Why not go from 2 cards to 3 instead. Apart from that I find the game very entertaining.

I used to really enjoy this game. Unfortunately it all goes downhill from here. I have played daily for the last 4 months getting up to level 263, the more and more I play the more I can recognise the patterns of the algorithm. I can literally predict which numbers are and aren't going to be daubed, power ups are pointless, ticket cost to keep playing ever increasing, in app purchases are ridiculously expensive for very little tickets. Such a shame because it could be so good.

what an absolute BS game, a total rip off, this is supposed to be fun even though you have to pay to progress. Just paid another £10 and gettin hardly any bingos and my credits are below half what i started with in less than an hour. Also secondary games never score any points, like 'granny rescue'. i would say, don't pay money to it, it's a scam! was enjoying it until I started spending money.

The game runs on a cycle, I've been playing for several months, it is extremely rare that you will win more than you bet. should you build up your balance by bonuses then the game takes the winnings back extremely quickly. In app purchases are extortionate in pricing for what you actually receive for your money. Try playing it yourself for a short period and you will soon see how this game runs on that cycle.

This game is one of the best bingo games around with good little side games. I play daily but the more you level up, the more difficult it becomes. I've spent real money to be able to play but it's not worth it as you lose tickets as quickly as you paid for them. spending money is cheap at first but then the prices shoot up to ridiculous amounts that just isn't worth paying for. it's such a shame because this game is one of the best but it seems to draw you in to then expect money from you.

Since the last big update the game has changed. I used to love this game and was happy to put money into it as the winning and losing was 50/50 give or take. You would have good runs then some bad but now it's just constant losing. The game has changed to push you into spending money but if you keep losing, what is the point? and also an offer pops up between every game, which is super annoying and it didn't use to

This has very limited enjoyment, you will get a small win, enough to play a few more games, then nothing, not a single bingo for 3 or 4 games, even with 4 or 6 cards, and it will dwindle your coins down enough that if you want to continue, you can't. I had 60,000 coins at one time (not winnings, just farming) and now nothing within a few games of playing, mugged off by a cheating game!

I installed this game from an ad in another game. That ad, which I was being plagued with, said you could win real cash. Well, I've not seen anything about this in the game. I came to the reviews to see if anyone had mentioned this, to find that playing the game is more likely to cost you money. It's a shame, as I like the game, especially as it has no ads. At least they didn't lie about that part. I'll be uninstalling as soon as this is posted.

Good game, no ads. removed a star as the main attraction is the little characters customisation but when you get to a high level apart from limited events, there is no more customisation and the game becomes impossible as you can have bad run after bad run. went from 174k to nothing so quick and not even through big bets, just constantly having awful game runs. shame as the game itself is great.

what a shame! this game is one of the most enjoyable ive played, the little side games are great, but the higher level you get to, the higher the price of bingo tickets to be able to participate in side games. it becomes impossible without spending real money, the prices start off low but inflate heavily with each purchase, your luck rarely improves! purchase rewards aren't great, only really gives u an extra round, maybe 2 if your lucky! gutting,could be great if it wasn't fixed to make u spend

I downloaded as part of the mistplay app. I have parted with some cash to get tokens to play with. This game strips you of all tokens very quickly so you can't play any more unless you spend more cash. Update. After being encouraged by their Devs to play the game more to be able to win more, I lost more. It's uncanny how the numbers picked are not on your card. - 1 star. Perfect example of being shafted by algorithms.

from 5 to 2 stars. initially it was great but becomes very apparent that if you would like to play more than a couple of games a day, you have to pay. there's no option to watch an ad to gain some tickets and the rewards in game are incredibly stingy, even with a purchase you won't get many games from what is offered. game play is great but on reflection, there are many other great bingo games out there that offer more than this one. uninstalled.

It's a great game, but very sexist. It takes a lot of time and effort to complete a level, and when you do, most of the the time it's heavily on the male characters side. I just completed level 17 and all three clothing options were male! What the hell?! Seriously! Ridiculously sexist! It's a shame because the game is great otherwise, but it still deserves 2 stars for such a huge oversight.

Way better than Bingo Blitz! You Level Up quickly and the payouts (not real $) are generous. The only ads are for in-game package deals (one tap closes them). For those times when you do fall short of credits for one more game, I wish the cost of their package deals were more reasonably priced. It will cost about $10 for enough credits to play 1 round (at lowest entry fee). I could go play 4 hours of REAL bingo for a chance to win REAL prizes at the local bingo hall for that.

found it really good to start with, but now the free tickets are really slow. at level 343, and game room 167.... yet not enough daily tickets for one game. each game costs 4000 minimum, yet only 3600 daily tickets. it doesn't work out at all. its literally pay to play now, plus once you bought a pack.... the prices go up and up. greedy game developers. game ruined.

Bingo Voyage is an entertaining game, with plenty of side quests to add interest. Unfortunately a crude algorithm that relentlessly increases the cost of play over time makes it unsustainable. The more you play, the more expensive it becomes: the cost of a game skyrockets, bingos become rarer and rarer, side quests appear unwinnable, money charged for game resources is extortionate. It really isn't worth playing after a while.

Love playing this game, however the rewards don't seem enough for the amount of tickets it costs to play. If you want big rewards you need to play with 4-6 cards and bet higher, but there's just not enough tickets earned from getting bingos. I can just about scrape through playing 4 games of bingo in one day before my tickets run out, and then have to wait til the next day. It's basically a pay to play game and nothing more.

The game has great graphics, has different games, and regularly brings new bingo games. On the downside, it takes a lot of the phone's memory (reached nearly 15Gb in my case) and increases as you reach higher levels. Purchases are required if you want to advance. and even then, it's not guaranteed.

I did enjoy playing this game. keeps me entertained, however you have to bet higher if you want to get puzzles and participate in events. With that, you can probably only play around 2-3 games per day unless you spend money. And as you play along the prices of ingame purchase also skyrocket. You rarely get even with your gameplay and you have to wait next day to regain game credit worth 1 gameplay unless you spend again. Expensive game if you want to keep playing.

I was really enjoying this game and got to level 102 in around 3 weeks. However, the amount of tickets it costs per game means unless you're having multiple rounds of double+ bingos, you're forever losing. The win rate decreases MASSIVELY and because of that, it became a monotonous cycle of loss after loss after loss, despite having multiple opportunities per card to win a bingo. I deleted the game.

Playing for a while now, it's been fun. Now almost impossible to BINGO, can only play 4-5 games until I'm out of dollars to play, then can't play again for 20 hours when I get the free daily dollars. The free bonus dollars aren't enough from the little side games to play any games because as you level up, games are very expensive. I've spent real dollars before, and have still never had more than about 3k BINGO dollars at any point. So I'm uninstalling, only because I don't want to pay to play.

This is the most annoying game ever. It constantly says "click to collect" yet it never works and the game constantly freezes. When you download it you get non stop jackpot bingos, but then once you get past the first few levels it's impossible to win any games at all unless you spend coins. Then when you do spend coins to get help, it doesn't even do anything.

I downloaded this game as a testerup task. Very quickly it becomes ridiculous. As you level up xp, the cost of tickets goes up, and it gets ridiculous. 3 for a single at lowest price (which doesn't give you what you need to complete the set) then the next price is 30!? Even that doesn't get things you need. You can claim daily in game cash but its not enough to stake what you need to progress, so you have to pay to win. Its now frustrating not fun at xp level 68.

First impressions of the game were good, a fun bright live bingo game with great visuals. However, it quickly becomes apparent that in order to be able to play regularly you have to pay. This is more apparent at later levels, where in order to win puzzle pieces, the cost of tickets is higher. What could have and should have been a fun game, turned out to be the opposite. The main aggravation is watching as the same people win over and over again, while your tickets are unchecked.

Bingo Voyage has gone downhill fast. You lose far more than you win, and tickets run out so quickly that you basically have to spend money—sometimes up to £80—for a chance to keep playing. Club battles were moved to weekends, removing a lot of the fun, and the algorithm now seems geared toward making you lose. Many players have noticed the drop in wins, especially once you progress past the first month. At this point, the game just feels like a money grab!

I'm unfamiliar with Bingo, so I found it overwhelming, way, way too fast and frustrating! The only way I got through any rounds was because sometimes it gives an hour of hints, but always when I couldn't play for long, and even then I still missed some with 4 boards. Definitely not for me! Looks like they put a lot of work into the game though, with decorating, online teams, card collection etc. lf you like Bingo this is probably great but with this experience I decided I do not like Bingo!

This started out as good but now a complete waste of time, paid well for winning at start now it barely pays back what you bet when you win. You manage to get about 1 possibly 2 games before you have to wait for daily allowance again. DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME WITH THIS GAME, I'm not sure how it's managed to get so many good ratings, if you don't believe me download it and find out for yourself. time to look for a more event fair playing game to install.

I believe this is one of the best bingo games out there as far as graphics and continually being interesting to play as I've been playing for about 2 months when typically I've given up after a week or two with other apps. HOWEVER it gets more and more expensive in game currency to play, im hardly afford to play a single round with 4cards with the free daily money. I enjoy it so much that I have spent actual money to play but even that gets more expensive each time you buy making it unaffordable

I'm only giving it a three star only because sometimes the game lags,freezes then kicks me out, annoying especially when your in a middle of a game, otherwise enjoying it so far,no annoying ads and haven't had to make a purchase so far,mind you I am only level 12 so early days,just wish the lagging and freezing would be sorted if so it would be five stars but until then I'll stay with three

Great game, let down by greed. The gameplay itself is addicting and really enjoyable. But why is it so expensive to play x4 cards of bingo. For example, it costs 400 tickets to play one round, and if you only have 500 tickets and you don't get a bingo that round, you can not play until the next day. Thus reaching the conclusion that you are required to spend money on tickets. When you do, you use them all again and left with 0. Just too greedy for my liking.

Very good game. Would of been 5 stars but the progression of the bingo game costs Vs per day income is unbalanced at higher tier. sometimes requires 3 days of daily collections to play a single round. The Purchase options pop up very regularly after every 3 rounds or so. it's annoying to have to close 6-7 pop ups just to continue to play. The game play itself is second to none however.

fun game until you buy something and then you get priced out of playing the game. Think it's ridiculous that you are charging more to players who make in-app purchases regularly. Basically punished for spending money. I would say don't bother with the game as hard to progress without purchasing.

I'm getting more and more certain they rig games when you have too much to try and get you to pay. What are the chances of playing 44 cards in a row with not one bingo? It doesn't make me want to keep playing the game, as it's only frustrating to keep wasting in-game currency, which is VERY hard to come by in the amounts needed to play the game. It's obvious that these kinds of games are designed to get your micro transactions, but they could at least be a little less obvious

Was fun and marginally addictive but the higher you go the more money starts to come into play or youll get a couple of games a day nothing more. Really doesn't help when you stop gaining items on the side quests. Yes I could get in touch and get support but its not worth the time and tbh developers shouldn't release games if they're glitchy.

this game brings a new element to bingo. easy to learn, easy to play, and easy to enjoy. multiple options when choosing your bids. only time ive noticed a set amountbneeded was for side games. power ups dont need a cooldown period which is AWESOME! but so far my favorite thing about this game is as you level up you unlock the ability to get multiple bingos on one card. the payouts are 1 bingo=1 card. so 4 cards 400=100 per card=100 per bingo. theres also other bingo games besides traditional

Upsides: nice art,no ads and nice people in global chat. Everything else is awful. You get enough tickets to play 1 or 2 cards every hour so if you lose you're sol. Everyone n chat seems 2 have the same problem I did, the higher you level up the more often you lose. Not uncommon at all to lose 20 games in a row even with power ups. Extremely expensive to play each card and the side games are impossibly expensive to play. Real glitchy. Ive had to restart my phone several times bc it freezes

$20, 0 bingos, 0 tickets , The game is fun BUT the tickets are very expensive as you level up & amount you win + purchase options dont even cover cost of a 4 ticket game & more if you want to advance in feature games. Ive also been waiting almost 2 months now to have someone resolve a loss of *32,000* tickets from an app crash seems its being intentionally avoided bc they have answered a simple question I had through the app help center & I have emailed them as well. Save your $$ DISSAPOINTING!

it ends up being kind of a purchase to play game. I only gave three stars because it is a fun, but it's obviously based on luck so you're not always winning as much as you're spending. that part is understandable of course because it's bingo. the annoying piece is that even if you do get several bingos, you're lucky if you earn as much as you spent, let alone a surplus. cash can run out quick and then you simply can't play. adjusting the winnings even a small amount would increase play time.

This game is a total nightmare and very frustrating. You are lucky to win even 1 bingo. It doesn't matter how high you bet, just a quicker way for you to loose your money. Everything about this game is horrible. To complete an album on a voyage takes way too long, because you'll get pics in duplicates and triplicates, furthermore, the collection of the other stickers is also a mission, you'll never complete all the albums. The cannons in game mode are also useless, does everything but a bingo

THIS IS NOT A BINGO GAME!!! SCAM ALERT ⚠️ 📢 First of all, you'll spend more time repairing the ship, deck gift shop etc. then to play after the first time, you have to pay real money and watch ads. Then the caller calls so fast, you can barely mark the cards. pop-ups constantly cover the numbers when they call and the numbers keep changing backgrounds while you're trying to play. I handle 40 cards at a casino with no problem. 4 cards on this thing is not relaxing in any way. UNINSTALLING!

At first, the game is fun and enjoyable to play. However, once you reach the higher levels, it becomes extremely boring and frustrating. Most of the time you don't win anything, and you just keep losing your bet points. The game feels heavily unbalanced, making progression more about luck than skill. Overall, it's a very disappointing experience and one of the worst bingo games I've played.

I've been playing for months now and enjoying the game but frustrated at the same time. occasionally I would have good luck, it's part of the game I understand. but when the ticket betting goes up doesn't match what you win ,it can be costly if you want to keep playing make ticket amount to bet optional for the player, not the game deciding, I'm close to deleting

SCAM! hit a big win once and you won't win again for a while. played 3 games with 6 cards each and didn't win anything, so now I'm stuck a few days to let the coins build up. I could buy some with actual money but $9.99 for 1,200 coins is extreme. added edit: don't play this. you'll waste money. deleted today and I hope everyone else does the same! the higher amount you pay, you'll lose ALL your coins

Extremely low win rate after the first few levels. Easily the worst Bingo game I've ever tried. No I don't want to join the Facebook page for a couple $ just to lose. Nor is there any incentive whatsoever to spend real money. The same bots win over and over. The ratings are clearly fake. Can't choose different bingo card games, so you play the same game over and over. Just no all around for this one. It's just so, so bad. Devs: Good games don't have to fake ratings.

the graphics are nice and vibrant, and there are lots of modes and side games which is cool. this fame is very much a pay to play/win model. you do not get enough tickets to play more than a couple games, and winning doesn't give enough for another game the vast majority of the time. and the cost of each match goes up each level, but the amount you win stays the same. you can always pay to buy more, but even then the price isn't very good, the 1.99 pack is 120 tickets when a match is 400 tickets

I have been playing this game since 3/17/26. I really enjoyed the game play and the payout was good enough to enjoy game play without having to make purchases. Now it's difficult to get bingos and enough money to keep playing. You have to pay in order to get rewards from all the side games. I have made purchases but am no longer willing to anymore as the cost went from 20 to 50 for the same amount of credits. In closing it starts out great but as you move up you need to pay. I don't recommend.

I really enjoy this game. play it basically every day. my only suggestion is that when you get to a certain level $50 in rewards just isn't enough. I'm at level 561. when the minimum bet to do anything good is about $5400 those small "prizes" from prize trunks or even daily bonus are just a slap it feels. I feel like when you cross different threshold levels those bonuses should increase. I've gone several days without playing because I'm trying to collect enough to money to play.

Worst thing about this game is the cost of "deals" 🤬 if you buy one today for 10 dollars it then goes up to 20. Every other game resets back to 10 on the next "deal" Well not this one. you buy the piggy bank for 10 once next is 20 then 40 then 60, and so forth. No resets at all ever. Been weeks, their loss, probably would've spent over 80 in a week instead I spent nothing.

Enjoyed the beginning of the game, but really frustrating as you climb levels. Bingos are fewer and far between, losing several hundred every single time and having to stop playing. Bingos move too fast, ensuring you never really break even. Got a "Lucky Smash" and ended up with over $18,000...and watched it slowly dwindle to nothing as I never made progress. If you could play consistently without having to dump more and more into the game, it would be an easy 5 star review.

Awesome game. Loved to play it. but the price per bingo round became so expensive that you have to save and collect for weeks to play a few rounds. the other option is to keep on buying more money to play. maybe consider dropping the Price per round per board so more people can play. its way expensive compared to other bingo games. but it's a good game. if you can play.

Like other comments. Fun game. Great graphics. Unfortunately, it gets expensive quickly. Started purchasing. However, even using the game with the lowest cost, it doesn't last long or earn enough to continue. It's a shame, but I can't afford it any longer. Good luck to you all. Uninstalled game.

Fun at first, but a massive money sink. After level 100 it's near impossible to play without paying a LOT. It takes at least 1 bingo PER CARD to win back the tickets it cost to play. Even at the lowest bet to unlock all the side games, you can lose $30+ dollars in bingo tickets in 10 minutes. So when the leveling bonuses slow down, the tickets needed to play dry up. At lvl 123, lost 2 days of free tickets in one round. I wouldn't mind spending a few bucks on regularly, not $50+ per week

I enjoy this game but the bugs/glitches have been awful lately. In the past 3 weeks I've had the same issue happen on the voyage journal, daily you collect a puzzle piece and some shell points JUST for logging in and for the past 3 weeks I've had atleast one day in the week where the piece has not been recieved and is just an empty fill bar with 0/1. I've tried to use the contact us feature on the game as soon as it has happened (w/ pics to show issue) but have had no response, not impressed! 😡

I'm only giving 3 stars because even though the game is fun and sometimes frustrating, I enjoy it. The problem is that I've recently noticed that I'm being charged on a recurring basis for purchases that I did not authorize. I have reached out to them using the help center. At first it responded, then it ended up ignoring me. I will update when and if this problem is resolved

Fun game, good graphics, but you can't play very many times a day, once you reach higher levels, unless you win a lot! Tickets to play get crazy expensive really fast, and they take several hours to refill. Kind of a bummer to play two rounds and have to quit for the day.

EDIT: Don't fall for the ads, they are extremely false and are nothing like the game. The game started off great, but as my level increased the amount of bingos I won decreased. I almost never win bingos anymore. Even if I do, the payout isn't enough to keep playing. I wouldn't recommend this game based solely on that fact. You put work in, only for it to be flushed down the toilet. App developer is GREEDY. 👎🏻

WORST BINGO GAME EVER.. DO NOT DOWNLOAD!! The game is fun at first, however, it's not random at all, so you know if you're going to win or lose and they make it so it's impossible to win because they want you to spend money, which doesn't make it fun anymore. And to spend money is an outrageous amount of money. Plus the payouts aren't worth it. You never win more than you spend, so you can maybe play 1 or 2 games, without spending money, and that's it! Horrible Game!

I love this game and play every night and have for months....until last night when I crashed and lost EVERYTHING. I had $12k, over 30k coins and 360+ power ups and now I'm at the 1st level with nothing. I've tried restarting it 3 times and everything is gone...I was using it through mistplay too and everything is just wiped out.

I am having a hard time playing this game with 4+ cards at a time, I wish it auto selected the tiles after so much time. Having to look at 6 cards and less than 60 seconds, you have a new number and column to look at, too, while the bonus tiles and bingos are reducing. There are too many distracting factors to play bingo without stress.

This is not a game for fun..they want you to spend your real money. It started off fun but clearly the developers are only trying to make money. They make levels harder and then on the hat game they want you to buy more coins to play as opposed to keeping the things you won during the hat game. They make it hard just to get the over 20,000 coins after the time period is up. This is BS overall. If I could sue I would!

I love this game. I've played it every day since installing it. I've even spent $$$ on it at times. Unfortunately, I was just starting out a new match where I bet 16k tickets, and then my phone ended up freezing, and I had to force restart it. My phone is a tad out of date. I came back and opened the app to see that the match went on, and I received nothing because I wasn't able to actually play it. Usually, when my phone freezes, it will refund my tickets, and it didn't this time, and I'm sad.

I have been playing this game for a while. now it has gotten out of control with its pricing. i play a lot of similar games online but without a doubt this is the most expensive game out there. to recharge for playing maybe 10 minutes costs you about $30!!!! time to uninstall and stop my support.....

so I guess I don't understand why I should spend money on Bingo Voyage if it nets me absolutely nothing. Long periods of no-bingo dry spells, but a ton of extra red-tier bonuses that either don't come up at all during gameplay or don't get daubed. I'm a long time player and it's way worse now than it used to be. Disappointed and deleting the app.

I have the same problem all the time..I'm playing a game and the app suddenly restarts and my account is gone..my Facebook and Google accounts are still available but my main account is gone ...I have to contact help and get a code to find it again..help has taken as long as a week to even respond to me.. recently it's happened twice in a week ...i keep being told to link my accounts but they're already in use..why does this keep happening?..I get so behind and I'm ready to give up altogether

Ive been playing this game for at least a year, when I first started it was GREAT then after a few "updates" the game just started falling flat, I complained that it was rigged... and amazingly the game improved... but now after the last "update" wins are far less often. I'm writing this review based on an ad that claims a JACKPOT every 3 games and endless tickets... both of these claims are bogus especially the Jackpot bingo every 3 games more like once in 3 months

I want to like this game but its nearly impossible to play the higher playing, multilevel boards and win more than you paid. I just got 4 of 6 bingos one a coverall and got 100 coins less then I paid to play. that's also after all the extra treasure too. * Just counting what I paid/won is about 200 loss even tho I got 4 bingos*

The advertisement show is winning real money I've been playing it for a long time I never want no real money and right now I'm at a spot work cost $600 to play one game and I believe it goes up from there as the ship moves from one place to another mad advertising bad if you're going to give her money don't if you're not going to get real money don't advertise that you do

fun, but a scam. You can get 6 bingos and not break even. It is constantly daubing the one number on the card you haven't marked yet, even if it is "random" (random statistically shouldn't happen every time), and if you need one more thing to complete an event it'll make you lose consistently to try to get you to spend real money. The "Luck" is completely rigged.

I really enjoy this game. However, they run your cash down so that you have to purchase more to play. The packs you can purchase are REALLY EXPENSIVE for a phone game. There are other bingo games that are more forgiving with a lot more features and side games giving you the opportunity to play without having to break your wallet.

this game was very cool until I started to see just how much they cheat i mean they cheat at an alarming rate. ive literally watched them not give me the things ive won. when you contact the help center it is powered by AI so there's no live agents. this game is a complete scam and I will get my money back one way or another!

Beware! There are a LOT of scammers on this app. They message you asking how you are and then try to move you to another app to "chat". This has happened 15 times to me and I have only been playing for a few days. It seems like they need to better regulate who is playing on their app. If you want to play the game I would suggest a general p,ayer name and a random profile picture. If you pick a gender one, you will be flooded with messages.

I was skeptical at first but now I really like this game . good rooms and fast paced and good graphics and better game play generally compared to other bingo games on apps etc , wish more play tickets were available though or able to be earnt e.g. by playing games on an offerwall you could earn them

if you are here from an ad you seen in another game you CANNOT WIN MONEY from this game you will get free tickets but not be enough to play more than two rounds after the first couple levels you will have to spend money to play it is a PAY TO PLAY game NOT pay to win ....PAY TO PLAY

No longer fun, too many bots and cheaters. It's almost impossible to win with the amount of cheating going on. It is also not possible to win after one ball call in a regular game, so what gives!? That is what I keep seeing!!! There is also no way to report these "people".

This game has a glitch, and it refuses to fix it.And customer service has twice given me bad code.So I can't get back to my game and of course.I paid for features on my game that are time sensitive and they are running out because I can't use them because I can access my game. Customer service is slow and non effective. i would just about pick any other bingo game because they are horrible.

The game is fun and well put together. There could be more detailed info for some side games. I notice the propellers and the cannons They create hope for help get that last spot! no just a lone box, or bounces too far missing the next card. The free daubs take out the same number as was called on the next card. the propellers hit the same number they're calling.

I absolutely love the game style.... love it... the huge problem is it is So hard to get bingos. so being able to play more then one or two game a day (unless on lowest cost, which you dont earn anything with.) is almost impossible. which is sad because who only wants to play one or two short games a day. when you finish side stuff (games,collections, leveling up, etc) you dont even get very much to be able to earn enough money to keep playing. It's the same if you pay for something.

update: as soon as I rated this game (originally five stars) and I made a purchase the game started crashing on me. now I'm having a problem with the game crashing, and misbehaving.
